note: Reads project the parsed model into one camelCase shape: paragraphs carry id, style, alignment, text and per-run text, bold, italic, underline, strike, fontSize in points, fontFamily (ascii, else hAnsi), color and styleId, with absent values as null; tables, sections, headers and footers nest those paragraphs. Body paragraphs include table cells and block content controls in document order. Exports and content-control reads take the camelCase options of every target unchanged. Edits replace one whole paragraph's text through a session with client id 1; the receipt records story, start, end and revisionIds, since paragraph keys are session-local. Every save sets updateModifiedDate false and the clock in now, so docProps/core.xml keeps its source bytes. A read after an edit follows openSaved, which reopens the bytes the last save wrote. renderPng records width, height and the count of pictures drawn as placeholders, never pixels. replaceParagraphTextAt addresses a body paragraph before the first table, where every target counts paragraphs alike.
